title: Affine chart comparison for stalk maps and relative differentials
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], $x\in X$, and $s=f(x)$. There exist affine open neighbourhoods $W=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of $x$ and $V=\operatorname{Spec}R$ of $s$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with $f(W)\subseteq V$ and induced ring map $\varphi:R\to A$ such that $A$ is finitely presented over $R$. If $\mathfrak q\subset A$ represents $x$, then $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ represents $s$. There are canonical ring isomorphisms $\mathcal O_{S,s}\cong R_{\mathfrak p}$ and $\mathcal O_{X,x}\cong A_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] under which the stalk map of $f$ is $R_{\mathfrak p}\to A_{\mathfrak q}$, $r/t\mapsto\varphi(r)/\varphi(t)$. For $M=\Omega_{A/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] there is a compatible $A_{\mathfrak q}$-linear isomorphism $\Omega^1_{X/S,x}\cong M_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-module-localization] sending the germ of $\mathrm da$ to $\mathrm da/1$. Consequently the stalk map is flat exactly when this localized ring map is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and, for every integer $r\geq0$, its differential stalk has a generating family of $r$ elements exactly when $M_{\mathfrak q}$ does.

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood V of f(x), then an affine neighbourhood W of x inside f inverse image V, using the affine-open basis. LocallyOfFinitePresentation.finitePresentation_appLE gives finite presentation of phi=f.appLE V W. Set q=hW.primeIdealOf(x).

IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE, the point form of the affine chart square, identifies q.comap(phi) with the prime of f(x). The two affine-open stalk localization instances and IsLocalization.algEquiv construct germ-preserving ring equivalences e and h. Compare h composed with f.stalkMap and Localization.localRingHom composed with e by IsLocalization.ringHom_ext. On a section r of V, germ_stalkMap_apply and germ_res_apply identify the left side with h(germ_W(phi(r))); the right side is algebraMap(phi(r)) by localRingHom_to_map and e.commutes. These agree by h.commutes. Thus the whole localized square commutes without transporting a Spec stalk square.

Relative differentials are quasi-coherent, as proved by the source instance isQuasicoherent_relativeDifferentials from their affine tilde description. Apply lem-sc-relative-differentials-affine-sections to obtain an A-linear equivalence c from Omega(A/R) to sections of Omega(X/S) on W, with c(da)=d(a). Apply lem-sbc-affine-module-germ-localization to the latter sheaf at x. Compose its actual germ localization g with c; IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv_right makes l=g composed with c a localization of Omega(A/R). The inverse E of IsLocalizedModule.iso identifies the ambient stalk with LocalizedModule(q.primeCompl,Omega(A/R)), and iso_symm_apply gives E(l(m))=m/1. Applying this to da gives the required derivation normalization. Give the target the ambient stalk-ring action through h. The germ-preserving formula for h identifies its restricted A-action with the canonical A-action, so IsScalarTower holds. LinearEquiv.extendScalarsOfIsLocalization extends E from A-linearity to stalk-ring linearity, exactly the required h-semilinearity.

RingHom.Flat.comp_iff_of_bijective_left and comp_iff_of_bijective_right transport flatness through h and e; the square from step 2 identifies the composed maps. For generating families, bundle the additive equivalence with its scalar formula as a semilinear equivalence. Map a family by this equivalence; Set.range_comp and Submodule.span_image identify its span with the image of the original span, and the image of top is top by surjectivity. Apply the inverse equivalence for the converse. This works also for the empty Fin 0 family and uses no positive-rank hypothesis.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affineChart_stalk_differentials {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (x : X) : ∃ (W : X.Opens) (V : S.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hx : x ∈ W) (hWV : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, W)), q = hW.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩ ∧ (f.appLE V W hWV).hom.FinitePresentation ∧ q.comap (f.appLE V W hWV).hom = hV.primeIdealOf ⟨f x, hWV hx⟩ ∧ ∃ (e : S.presheaf.stalk (f x) ≃+* Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (f.appLE V W hWV).hom).asIdeal) (h : X.presheaf.stalk x ≃+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (theta : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj f.relativeDifferentials ≃+ LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential (f.appLE V W hWV))), (∀ r : Γ(S, V), e (S.presheaf.germ V (f x) (hWV hx) r) = algebraMap _ _ r) ∧ (∀ a : Γ(X, W), h (X.presheaf.germ W x hx a) = algebraMap _ _ a) ∧ (∀ b : S.presheaf.stalk (f x), h (f.stalkMap x b) = Localization.localRingHom (q.comap (f.appLE V W hWV).hom).asIdeal q.asIdeal (f.appLE V W hWV).hom rfl (e b)) ∧ (∀ (b : X.presheaf.stalk x) (m : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj f.relativeDifferentials), theta (b • m) = h b • theta m) ∧ (∀ a : Γ(X, W), theta (f.relativeDifferentials.presheaf.germ W x hx (f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d a)) = LocalizedModule.mk (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := f.appLE V W hWV) a) 1) ∧ ((f.stalkMap x).hom.Flat ↔ (Localization.localRingHom (q.comap (f.appLE V W hWV).hom).asIdeal q.asIdeal (f.appLE V W hWV).hom rfl).Flat) ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, (∃ v : Fin r → (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj f.relativeDifferentials, Submodule.span (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Set.range v) = ⊤) ↔ ∃ v : Fin r → LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential (f.appLE V W hWV)), Submodule.span (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (Set.range v) = ⊤)
